Project archive / Offline edition

Glide.

An evolution in 6 eras

A standalone Hermes Agent plugin that turns Hermes into an agent workspace inside Tern. Glide guards two scarce resources, your attention and the agent's context window, and draws its work as native cards you can inspect and approve.
